name: Foot Washing
overview: Foot washing in Scripture is portrayed as an act of hospitality and humility, as seen in Genesis where guests are offered water to wash their feet after travel (Genesis 18:4; 19:2; 24:32). In the New Testament, Jesus elevates this practice to a profound spiritual lesson, demonstrating servant leadership by washing His disciples' feet and teaching that participation in His kingdom requires humility and cleansing (John 13:1, 8). The act also serves as a tangible expression of repentance and devotion, exemplified by the woman who washed Jesus' feet with her tears and hair (Luke 7:44).
